text:
raja: heads up — noticed a repro for tenant bleed in console previews. steps: quick org switch -> open run preview -> shows snippet from other org. can reproduce reliably when quota fallback triggers.

maria: ugh. which fallback? region -> shared fallback?

raja: yes, when routing policy falls back from dedicated pool to shared (cost-tier) because the request hit burst/quota limit. seems like the preview fetch is routed to a downstream proxy that doesn't forward x-tenant-hint.

sre-jen: do we have logs/trace id for one example?

raja: pasted one below 
```
2024-06-12T15:12:03Z INFO proxy-request id=abc123 route=shared-fallback upstream=/ui/preview tenant_hint=ORG:54321 forwarded_headers=[authorization,cookie]
2024-06-12T15:12:03Z INFO preview-fetch id=abc123 upstream_resp=200 cached=false owner=ORG:98765
```

leo: whoa owner mismatch. preview-fetch sees owner=ORG:98765 while tenant_hint was 54321. that implies header dropped or overridden downstream.

infra-bot: bucket=shared-fallback pool=spot-gpu-2 free=12/16 throttle=soft-limit=true

maria: could be KV cache key collision? previews use prefix caching keyed by model+prompt, maybe cache is global for shared pool and we accidentally surface last-rendered owner.

raja: i checked cache keys — they include prompt hash + model but NOT tenant id for the preview cache layer. seems historically we omitted tenant to maximize dedupe across small previews.

sre-jen: that seems risky. dedupe ok for embeddings but previews contain user org metadata. we should never share across tenants. P0?

leo: agree P0 for data exposure. quick mitigation: patch proxy to always inject x-tenant-id into preview fetch and make cache key include tenant id. also put a temporary gate: if fallback route is shared-fallback then disable preview caching.

ops-tom: can we scope a short-term rollout? hotfix to proxy + cache toggle, then config change to routing policy to prefer cold-start burst instead of shared fallback for preview endpoints.

maria: +1. also we need a signal in telemetry to find customers impacted (preview_owner_mismatch events). add metric: preview.owner_mismatch_count with tags for route/pool.

leo: i'll open PR for cache-key change. raja can you own proxy header fix and a prod rollback plan?

raja: on it. i'll add a quick guard in the proxy to assert header preservation and 5xx if missing (fail closed). then rollout to canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

sre-jen: when you patch, add automated runbook step to invalidate preview cache entries for shared-pool between 1718000000..1718006000 window. also coordinate with CS for impacted orgs.

raja: noted. i'll schedule cache invalidation job after canary ok.

infra-bot: scheduled rollback window 2024-06-12T18:00Z if incidents reported.

maria: thanks. can we also add an integration test that verifies tenant header flows across routing fallbacks? small harness under eng-tests.

leo: yep i'll add e2e in eng-tests that simulates quota-exhaustion and asserts cache keys include tenant and previews never return owner header from other tenant.

ops-tom: created incident ticket INC-2024-486 and linked to this thread. CS pinged for triage.

raja: quick note: this only affects preview endpoints (/ui/preview and /api/v1/preview) not core model generation endpoints which already include tenant in cache keys.

sre-jen: good. keep updates here. thanks for catching quickly :thumbsup:
